text: DSH Workspace Switch 是面向 DSH Web 工作区的能力开关插件。它在工作区菜单加入设置入口，通过对话框查看当前部署提供的插件、MCP 服务和技能，并为单个工作区启用或停用这些能力。主机端读取工作区配置，在对应 agent 作用域隐藏停用的技能并限制相关工具；配置可存于 DSH 共享目录或项目目录。适合需要让不同项目使用不同能力集合的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

DSH Workspace Switch adds controls to the DSH web interface. A workspace menu dialog lets users enable or disable listed plugins, MCP servers, and skills. The host applies settings to that workspace’s agent. Configuration uses a shared DSH store or project file; no API key is required.
想给不同 DSH 工作区配置不同的技能和工具。
如何在一个项目里单独关闭某个 MCP 服务？
I want to turn off selected plugins or skills for one workspace only.
DSH Workspace Switch 的功能「工作区能力开关」：从工作区菜单打开对话框，按插件、MCP 服务和技能分类查看能力并切换启用状态；主机端将设置应用到该工作区对应 agent。
DSH Workspace Switch 的功能「项目级配置」：为工作区保存独立的能力设置；项目内 .dsh/workspace-switch.json 可覆盖 DSH 共享配置，未配置时沿用部署的全局能力。

dsh-workspace-switch README · dsh-workspace-switch：Per-workspace activation control for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
each workspace decides which **plugins**, **MCP servers**, and **skills** its
sessions may use, and a dialog on the workspace row edits that decision.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-workspace-switch README · What it does：- **Host half** (`index.js`, built to `lib/index.js`) reads the per-workspace
  configuration when an Agent is created and applies it to that Agent's own
  Cordis scope, so two Agents in two workspaces inside one harness process see
  different capabilities:
  - a disabled **skill** is shadowed in that scope by a same-name
    non-invocable registration, which removes it from the model's skill
    catalog;
  - a disabled **MCP server** has every `mcp__<serverName>__*` tool denied in
    that scope;
  - a disabled **plugin** has the tool names its entry declares denied in that
    scope.
  The same half serves the configuration routes the dialog uses.
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`, built to `lib/client.js`) adds one row to a
  workspace's `...` menu. It opens a dialog listing what the running
  composition offers under each category, with a switch per capability.

dsh-workspace-switch README · What it does：A workspace with no entry inherits the deployment's composition unchanged, so
the plugin changes nothing until a workspace is configured.

dsh-workspace-switch README · Configuration：`enabled: false` switches a capability off for that workspace; an absent entry
means enabled. A plugin entry also declares the **tool names** the plugin
registers — the gate denies tools by name, so a plugin without `tools` has
nothing to deny.

The dialog writes the document that currently answers for the workspace: the
project file while one exists, the shared store otherwise. Output is published
through a temp-file rename, so a reader never sees a half-written document.

dsh-workspace-switch README · Install：The plugin is a DSH bundle: add it to a profile and select it.

```sh
dsh plugin add link:/path/to/dsh_workspace_switch
```

then add `dsh-workspace-switch` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. A new
bundle row loads at the next harness start.

dsh-workspace-switch README · Build：The browser half is a DSH client bundle and must be built; the repository
toolchain is required (the plugin vendors its copy of the client build preset at
`scripts/tsdown.client.ts`, which resolves the harness sources from the checkout
it sits in).

```sh

dsh-workspace-switch README · from a deepseek-harness checkout：pnpm exec tsdown --config dsh_workspace_switch/tsdown.config.ts   # or, inside the plugin: pnpm build
pnpm exec tsc -p dsh_workspace_switch/tsconfig.typecheck.json     # typecheck the browser half
node --test "tests/**/*.test.js"                                  # unit tests
```

dsh-workspace-switch README · from a deepseek-harness checkout：**`lib/` is committed.** The package's `main` and `./client` both point into it,
and a clone has neither the harness sources nor a build toolchain, so a
build-from-source install (`dsh plugin add github:…`) would otherwise install a
package with no entry points. Commit the rebuilt files with any change that
alters them.

dsh-workspace-switch README · from a deepseek-harness checkout：A standalone clone cannot run the build: the vendored preset imports the harness
sources (`../../packages/…`, `../../scripts/…`) that only exist inside a
checkout. Build inside the checkout, then commit `lib/` here.

dsh-workspace-switch README · Known limitations：- **Skills are gated, not unloaded** — a disabled skill keeps its files on
  disk; only its catalog entry and loading are removed for that workspace.
- **A plugin needs declared tools** — the gate denies tools by name, so
  switching a plugin off only removes what its entry names in `tools`.
- **The dialog lists what the Host can address** — plugin rows come from the
  profile's plugin manager (or the read-only inventory); a capability the
  composition does not expose cannot be configured.
dsh-workspace-switch README · Licence：MIT.
